title: React visualization system for Cynthia logs
description: Build a client-side React app to visualize Cynthia LTLf synthesis execution logs with state graphs, timeline, log viewer, and statistics dashboard

title: Setup React project with Vite and dependencies
description: Initialize Vite + React TypeScript app. Install visualization libraries: React Flow (for state graph), D3 or vis.js alternatives. Configure Tailwind CSS for styling.

comments.text:
COMPLETED: Successfully initialized Vite + React TypeScript app with all required dependencies.

Created files:
- package.json with dependencies (reactflow, tailwindcss, @tailwindcss/postcss, etc.)
- vite.config.ts for Vite build configuration
- tsconfig.json, tsconfig.app.json, tsconfig.node.json for TypeScript
- tailwind.config.js and postcss.config.js for Tailwind CSS
- src/App.tsx with basic React Flow example component
- src/index.css with Tailwind directives
- All other necessary project files

The app builds successfully and includes:
1. Vite + React + TypeScript setup
2. React Flow library for state graph visualization
3. Tailwind CSS configured with PostCSS
4. Basic example showing React Flow with 2 nodes and 1 edge
5. TypeScript strict mode enabled

To run the app:
  cd .worktrees/bd-cynthia_visualize-tey.1
  npm install
  npm run dev

title: Log parser for Cynthia execution logs
description: Create parser to convert Cynthia log format into structured JSON data. Parse: timestamps, log levels, states, transitions, system/env moves, realizability checks, loops, statistics.

title: State graph visualization component
description: Interactive node-link diagram using React Flow. Show states as nodes, transitions as edges. Color-code by state type (failure, success, loop). Support zoom, pan, click to inspect.

title: Execution timeline component
description: Timeline view of execution flow with expandable steps. Show system moves, environment responses, realizability checks. Allow step-by-step navigation and inspection.

title: Interactive log viewer
description: Log viewer with search/filter functionality. Highlight by log level (info, debug). Link log entries to corresponding state graph nodes. Expandable/collapsible sections.

title: Statistics dashboard
description: Summary cards showing: total states explored, execution time, realizability result, transition counts, loop detection count. Visual charts for key metrics.

title: Main layout and integration
description: Create main app layout integrating all components. Add file upload for .log files. Implement responsive design. Add loading states and error handling.
